name: W Xi'an
insider_take: Where ancient dynasty energy meets cutting-edge W attitude — W Xi'an sits steps from the legendary Tang Paradise and the Great Wild Goose Pagoda, blending 1,400 years of history with unapologetically bold modern luxury.
whats_special: W Xi'an dramatically overlooks Tang Paradise Lake, offering sweeping views of one of China's most celebrated cultural landmarks. The hotel's design draws boldly from the golden Tang Dynasty aesthetic — think lacquered reds, sculptural lanterns, and ornate motifs reimagined through W's signature avant-garde lens. As part of the Marriott Luminous program , Marriott Bonvoy members earn elevated points on every stay, making luxury even more rewarding.
pro_tip: Book a Tang Paradise Lake-view room and time your check-in for dusk — the nightly light show over the pagoda and lake is nothing short of spectacular, and you'll have the best seat in Xi'an right from your own room.
dont_miss: The iconic Terracotta Warriors are just a short drive away — a true once-in-a-lifetime experience. Back at the hotel, the WET® pool deck and W's signature AWAY® Spa offer a sleek urban retreat after a day of exploring Xi'an's ancient Muslim Quarter and centuries-old City Wall.
pros: Prime location near Xi'an's historic attractions and Terracotta Warriors
Signature W Hotels modern design and vibrant lifestyle atmosphere
High-end amenities including spa, fitness center, and innovative dining
Contemporary rooms with luxury furnishings and city views
cons: Trendy hotel style may not appeal to traditional luxury travelers
